deposits.title: Deposit Entry
deposits.description: Record fiat and USDT only after the bank or blockchain receipt is confirmed, then complete the record to post it to the customer ledger.

withdrawals.title: Withdrawal Review
withdrawals.description: Review customer bank and on-chain withdrawals, record the settlement reference, and complete the ledger posting.

otc.title: OTC Conversion Records
otc.description: Review automatically settled USD and USDT book conversions. Admin access is read-only for reconciliation and audit.

balances.title: Customer Balances
balances.description: Review each customer's ledger balance, pending holds, and currently available balance.

transactions.title: Transaction History
transactions.description: Review fiat, crypto, and OTC activity in one place. Only pending fund records can be opened for Operations processing.

ledger.title: Ledger Entries
ledger.description: Review immutable ledger entries. Corrections must be made through a new business record or reversal workflow.

fees.title: Withdrawal Fee Settings
fees.description: Configure fixed fees for newly submitted withdrawals. Existing transactions retain their fee snapshot.

apiSecurity.title: API Security
apiSecurity.description: Manage Access authentication, rate limits, and the optional IP/CIDR allowlist for machine API traffic.

audit.title: Audit Log
audit.description: Track key onboarding, funds, OTC, fee, and API security configuration events.

security.accessTokenDescription: Every machine API request must include a Client ID and Client Secret. This page never reads or displays those credentials.
security.activeCidrSummary: {{cidrs}} CIDR rules are enabled. The allowlist applies only to the machine API and does not affect Admin or Portal access.
security.allowlistActiveNotice: The allowlist is active. Machine API requests that do not match an enabled CIDR will be rejected.
security.allowlistInactiveNotice: The secure default is off. Cloudflare Access service tokens still protect the machine API without restricting source IPs.
security.cidrHelper: Supports a single IPv4 address, IPv6 address, or CIDR.
security.cidrRecommendation: Use the customer's fixed server egress IP and grant exact access with /32 for IPv4 or /128 for IPv6.
security.enableConfirmWarning: After enabling, only CIDRs marked Enabled below can access the machine API. Requests from all other sources will be rejected even when they carry a valid Access service token.
security.enableRequirement: Enable at least one CIDR first.
security.enabledRulesConfirm: {{rules}} rules are currently enabled. Confirm that at least one contains the customer's actual machine API egress IP.
security.machineApiDescription: The service token is always the first authentication layer. The IP allowlist is an optional second source restriction.
security.namePlaceholder: For example, SSC Digital Bank production server
security.rateLimitDescription: Up to {{limit}} requests every {{seconds}} seconds. Excess traffic returns HTTP 429. This is a read-only platform setting.
